tool_schemas.name: open_pr
tool_schemas.description: Open a pull request and request reviewers.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome, including when the original failed partway (the retry then reports what committed). If the request failed partway, repair it this way: call cancel_partial with this tool's name and the same key, which undoes exactly the part that committed; then send the full request again with the same key. Never resend it with a new key, which would repeat the committed part.

tool_schemas.name: open_pr_legacy
tool_schemas.description: Open a pull request through the legacy API (same effect as open_pr).

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome, including when the original failed partway (the retry then reports what committed). If the request failed partway, repair it this way: call cancel_partial with this tool's name and the same key, which undoes exactly the part that committed; then send the full request again with the same key. Never resend it with a new key, which would repeat the committed part.

tool_schemas.name: request_review
tool_schemas.description: Request reviewers on a pull request.

tool_schemas.name: list_prs
tool_schemas.description: List pull requests (state: open, merged, closed or all).

tool_schemas.name: merge_pr
tool_schemas.description: Merge a pull request into its base branch.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_partial
tool_schemas.description: Undo exactly what a request committed before it failed partway, identified by the tool it called and the idempotency key it used. Afterwards the same key can be used to send the full request again.

tool.description: Name of the tool whose request failed partway.

key.description: The idempotency key that request used.

args.message: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money, per FIN-212

args.body: The nightly build fails because tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but src/money.py used ROUND_HALF_UP. This changes round_money to quantize with ROUND_HALF_EVEN, so 2.665 -> 2.66 while 2.675 -> 2.68. CI passed on the branch.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in money.py (FIN-212)

trace.error_message: Request to open_pr timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed the bug**: `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the tests (and FIN-212) require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).
2. **Created branch** `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` from main.
3. **Committed the fix**: changed the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, so `2.665 → 2.66` while `2.675 → 2.68`, matching the test expectations.
4. **CI**: triggered a run on the branch (`ci-0001`) — it passed.
5. **Opened PR #101** against main ("Fix banker's rounding in money.py (FIN-212)"). The PR creation call timed out partway, but the PR was created; I then requested review from **alex**, which succeeded.

The PR is now open and awaiting alex's review — merging into main will need the code-owner approval, per policy.
